metadata.description: DSH 会话文档台账插件：记录每个会话使用/创建/修改过哪些文档，支持时间排序、类型分组、搜索、预览与跨会话汇总。 A DSH sidebar plugin: per-session document ledger — which documents a session read, created or modified — with time ordering, type grouping, search, two preview modes and a cross-session view. Windows only.
metadata.name: dsh-doc-ledger
